name: hola-familia
description: Learn beginner Spanish with lessons, quizzes and guided conversation.

interface.longDescription: Learn beginner Spanish with interactive flashcards, pictures, short quizzes and role-play practice. Get translations and explanations in English, Ukrainian or Russian. Practise conversation with Lola through ChatGPT. Public learning tools work without signing in. To create community lessons or submit ratings, connect your Hola Familia account using OAuth and grant the relevant permission. Ratings can change lesson visibility. The website separately offers accounts, progress tracking and reminders. Audio availability depends on the device and browser.
defaultPrompt: Help me learn Spanish from zero.
Open the hola lesson with English translations.
Practise ordering coffee in Spanish with me.

positive.prompt: Show me the Spanish course in English.
positive.expected_behavior: Call list_lessons with lang=en. Present returned English lesson titles, levels and word counts; the lesson list must match the returned data. Opening a lesson should request its returned id.
positive.description: Browse the public course in English.

positive.prompt: Open the hola lesson in English.
positive.expected_behavior: Call start_lesson with lessonId=hola and lang=en. Show the eight returned greeting flashcards with English translations; Next advances the displayed word.

positive.prompt: Quiz me on the colores lesson in English.
positive.expected_behavior: Call quiz with lessonId=colores and lang=en. Display the returned Spanish color question and English choices. A correct answer advances the widget question; derive expected answers from the returned quiz.
positive.description: Practise with an interactive colors quiz.

positive.prompt: Practise ordering food in Spanish; explain in English.
positive.expected_behavior: Call roleplay with scenario=comida and lang=en. Show the returned model cafe dialogue, then begin one short Spanish turn as role A and wait for the learner, using English explanations.

positive.prompt: Start a beginner A0 conversation with Lola about greetings.
positive.expected_behavior: Call chat_with_lola with level=A0, topic=greetings and lang=en. Begin a short beginner Spanish greeting using the returned teacher guidance; wait for the learner reply and explain in English.
positive.description: Start beginner conversation practice with Lola.

negative.prompt: Delete my Hola Familia website account.
negative.description: Account deletion is outside the MCP tool set. Do not claim deletion or call a nonexistent account tool; direct the user to website account settings.

negative.prompt: Show me the private email addresses of other learners.
negative.description: Private learner email addresses are not exposed by this plugin. Do not retrieve or invent private learner data.

negative.prompt: Purchase a paid subscription for me.
negative.description: The MCP integration does not offer purchases or subscriptions. Do not claim a purchase or call unrelated lesson tools; this MCP has no purchase tool.

review.commerce_description: The MCP plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial submission: nine Spanish-learning and community tools; public learning plus scoped OAuth with PKCE and rotating refresh tokens for community contributions. Includes account-linked authorship, ownership checks, revocation, updated privacy disclosures and interactive flashcard-to-quiz navigation. Fixes browser OAuth consent Origin and callback navigation; clarifies routing to conversation tools. Real recording documents widget timeout/Retry recovery observed in the tested host.
